entries.label: calculator
entries.whyLarge: CalculatorGridClient is now a non-critical composition owner: it connects focused session, input, validation, costing-result, infill, save, house-footprint, blinds, flashings, and presenter owners into the configuration schema and workspace props. Estimate/project loading and duplicate-draft orchestration live in useCalculatorWorkspaceSession; result-derived presentation lives in useCalculatorResultPresentation; the outer calculator workspace shell lives in CalculatorWorkspaceView; house-footprint editor gesture/lifecycle state lives in useCalculatorHouseFootprintController; and standalone/project route ownership lives in calculatorWorkspace. Pure calculator input defaults, normalization, validation construction, browser-draft persistence/session state, module navigation modelling and presentation, job/module input mutation policy, configuration-section definitions/presentation/field options, structure/site/workflow field-schema generation, issue labels/section ownership/model construction/focus navigation, blinds input drafts and mutations, flashings mutations and primary-length synchronization, infill draft/selection/modal/delete-undo state, infill item mutations/stage policy, infill clipboard/hotkeys/warning focus/telemetry, infill baseline/variant cost coordination, infill dialog/stage/rail/empty-state presentation, save confirmation/persistence/outcome orchestration, blinds/flashings custom editor markup, materials-debug request/lifecycle/export behavior, warnings/BOM/debug/labour/structure preview presentation, pricing-summary presentation, preview-split sizing and persistence, price-impact ranking/presentation and styles, save-readiness, quote-status/save-preflight helpers, guided infill stages, infill UI/payload plus summary view-model helpers, and save dialog presenters also live outside CalculatorGridClient.
entries.nextSafeExtraction: Do not split solely for size; if future calculator work expands the client, extract configuration-schema or workspace-prop assembly as a named composition owner before adding inline behavior.

entries.label: design workbench
entries.ownerArea: Drawing workbench UI and drawing domain adapters
entries.whyLarge: Viewports, render graph wiring, interaction state, compatibility fallbacks, and browser gestures are still being separated.
entries.nextSafeExtraction: Move pure interaction math, render preparation, and compatibility adapters out of viewport presenters before adding new tools or overlays.
focusedTests: browser fixture smoke when UI changes

entries.label: geometry package
entries.whyLarge: Solvers, house model contracts, projections, and fixtures are central package truth with broad consumers.
entries.nextSafeExtraction: Split solver phases, normalized model contracts, and projection helpers by physical responsibility while preserving public package exports.

entries.label: schedule
entries.whyLarge: Board, Gantt, Site Visits, readiness, and legacy fallback remain heavy interactive surfaces.
entries.nextSafeExtraction: Extract workflow-specific clients, query/view models, and command adapters before adding new schedule modes.

entries.label: project quote tab
entries.whyLarge: QuotesTab is just above the critical threshold and composes named selection/query, lifecycle, PDF-preview, modal, list, detail, and pure-model owners. Draft editing, local-first create/persist, send-form orchestration, and prepared-delivery recovery state remain in the composition owner; the actual frozen-intent read/retry and dialog presentation are already extracted.
entries.nextSafeExtraction: Extract a useQuoteDeliveryRecovery controller, then draft editing plus local-first create/persist orchestration, before adding another inline quote workflow.

entries.label: commercial quote and invoice server workflow
entries.ownerArea: Server-owned quote delivery, acceptance, and deposit invoice workflow
entries.whyLarge: Quote persistence/detail reads, artifact preparation, public-token delivery, acceptance, deposit invoice creation, provider checkpoints, and replay-safe finalisation cross several historical server modules. Stable commercial intent, audit, acceptance, and route-delivery owners are extracted, but the older quote and invoice modules still assemble multiple collaborators.
entries.nextSafeExtraction: Move quote payload and attachment preparation out of serverEmail, split draft command/detail-read coordination out of serverCore, and move deposit-invoice render/token/log finalisation out of invoices/server without changing the commercial RPC or frozen-intent boundary.

entries.label: marketing enquiry route
entries.ownerArea: Public enquiry intake and conversion workflow
entries.whyLarge: Request validation, indicative estimate preparation, project/contact/enquiry persistence, attachment staging, autoresponder delivery, outbox recording, attribution, and audit fallback still meet in one public route.
entries.nextSafeExtraction: Move enquiry persistence and autoresponder/outbox audit orchestration behind named domain owners before JOB-07 migrates accepted delivery work; keep authentication-independent request validation and truthful response shaping in the route.

entries.label: marketing start
entries.whyLarge: Page-level presentation, product selection, conversion copy, and interaction paths are concentrated in one public page.
entries.nextSafeExtraction: Extract section components, content data, and conversion state helpers before adding new campaign branches.

entries.label: marketing product catalogue
entries.ownerArea: Public product content, claims, media and route identity
entries.whyLarge: The approved product redesign deliberately consolidates ten previously fragmented product sources into one typed, reviewable public-claim owner. It contains static governed copy and relationships only; page composition, metadata rendering, interaction, project records and enquiry behavior remain separate owners. Repeated project-image focal positions stay in the dedicated projectImageFraming helper rather than becoming record-local framing logic.
entries.nextSafeExtraction: If the catalogue grows beyond these ten records, retain apps/marketing/data/products.ts as the only public export and move byte-for-byte record groups into private category modules behind that boundary. Do not recreate independent route, image, SEO or technical-content maps.
